'''Stim plugs''' were small electronic devices used to awaken or revive patients. They were a standard device used by [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]]. They likely used a small electronic discharge as well as a dose of [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulant]] to revive patients.

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Oddly, the stim plug used to revive [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] in "[[Downfall of a Droid]]" was placed on his robotic arm. Since the device was only described and named in the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars#The Clone Wars: Decoded|''Decoded'']] annotations for the episode, it is unclear if the animators originally intended for it to be a device that effected his biological or robotic parts.
